description: A legacy index in a JSON string makes static traversal analysis an error
notes: The spec reads the string as a native syntax expression and delegates to its static traversal analysis, where the legacy index .0 is an index step. hashicorp/hcl parses the string with hclsyntax.ParseTraversalAbs instead of as an expression (expression.AsTraversal in json/structure.go), and that parser requires an attribute name after a dot (parseTraversal in hclsyntax/parser_traversal.go).
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
